function_v0.doc:
Read a wallet's attestation.

Multi-wallet resolution (Option A \xe2\x80\x94 shared group score): if the wallet's
own attestation carries an `identity_commitment` and a WalletIdentity
contract is configured, the shared group attestation is returned instead,
so any wallet in the group surfaces the same group score. That group score
is a *holistic union* re-score (the off-chain attestor's `attest_group`
merges every member wallet's on-chain history and scores it as one
economic actor), not a per-wallet "best score" cherry-pick \xe2\x80\x94 one bad
wallet cannot be hidden behind a better-scoring one in the same group.
The querying wallet's own record is never exposed when a group score is
available.
function_v0.name: get_attestation

function_v0.doc: Optimistic hash-anchored attestation path.  Stores the attestation\nwithout on-chain proof verification.  `zk_verified` is always false.
function_v0.name: attest_with_hash

function_v0.doc:
Full Groth16 on-chain verification path.

If a verification key for `data.distilled_model_hash` has been registered
via `register_verification_key`, the proof is verified on-chain and
`zk_verified` is set to `true`.  Otherwise falls back to the hash-anchored
path with `zk_verified = false` (DG1 fallback behaviour).
function_v0.name: attest_with_proof

function_v0.doc:
Attest a wallet's risk from a RISC Zero zkVM Groth16 receipt (the distilled-model
guest). Verifies the receipt against the whitelisted image id, then binds the proven
journal fields (risk_bucket, confidence, identity_commitment, distilled_model_hash)
into the stored attestation with `zk_verified = true`.

`seal` is the Groth16 proof (a|b|c, 256 bytes; selector stripped); `journal` is the
72-byte guest journal. Caller supplies the non-proven metadata in `data` (attestor,
timestamps, model hashes); the proven fields are overwritten from the journal so the
stored record always reflects the proof.
Attest \xe2\x80\x94 or **re-attest** \xe2\x80\x94 a wallet from a RISC Zero receipt.

Unlike the hash/proof paths, this is no longer write-once: a wallet can
re-attest after further on-chain activity to refresh its score. The only
guard is monotonicity \xe2\x80\x94 `data.issued_at` must be strictly newer than the
stored attestation's \xe2\x80\x94 so an older (possibly better) signed attestation
cannot be replayed to shed a worse, more recent score. On-cha
function_v0.name: attest_with_risc0

function_v0.doc: Register the whitelisted RISC Zero guest image id (the distilled-model guest).\nAdmin-only. Only receipts from this image verify in `attest_with_risc0`.
function_v0.name: set_risc0_image_id

function_v0.doc: Set the WalletIdentity contract address. Admin-only. Optional: when set,\n`get_attestation` resolves a wallet's `identity_commitment` to the shared\ngroup attestation (multi-wallet reputation sharing).
function_v0.name: set_wallet_identity

function_v0.doc: Set the AttestorRegistry contract address. Admin-only.
function_v0.name: set_attestor_registry

function_v0.doc: Register a Groth16 verification key for a distilled model.\nAdmin-only.  Must be called before `attest_with_proof` can set\n`zk_verified = true` for attestations using that model.
function_v0.name: register_verification_key

tuple_v0.doc:
Sybil-resistance registry: maps an opaque KYC nullifier (HMAC of the
verified document, computed off-chain \xe2\x80\x94 never raw PII) to the single
identity commitment it is bound to. One verified human \xe2\x86\x92 one nullifier \xe2\x86\x92
at most one identity group. Stored by WalletIdentity::bind_kyc.
tuple_v0.name: NullifierCommitment

tuple_v0.doc: Whether an identity group (commitment) has a bound KYC nullifier, i.e. is\nKYC-verified. Set by bind_kyc; overlaid onto the group AttestationData so\nKYC survives regardless of scoring order. commitment \xe2\x86\x92 bool.
tuple_v0.name: KycVerified

fields.doc: Poseidon(secret) commitment that links this wallet to an identity group.\nNone means the wallet is not enrolled in any multi-wallet group.

fields.doc:
Attestor-certified KYC status, bound via a Sybil-resistant nullifier
(WalletIdentity::bind_kyc). The credit *gate* in lending: only a
kyc_verified identity gets real borrowing capacity (anti-wallet-hopping);
un-KYC'd wallets get thin-file terms.
fields.name: kyc_verified
